title: International RSE Survey 2017 — Germany
text:
Survey overview
This book presents the 2017 survey independently for Germany, using the questions and answer options stored in that year’s export.
Country scope: Germany
Source records: 951
Records matching country scope: 325
Respondents included: 325
Question groups discovered: 59
This export has no submitdate_0 field, so all 325 rows are included.
Only respondents whose socio1_0 value is Germany are included.
No cross-year harmonisation is applied.
